newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia foreign reserves at new $10.24 bln record.
newsitem.headline: Colombia foreign reserves at new $10.24 bln record.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves stood at $10.24 billion -- a new historic high -- as of June 13, the last date for which official figures are available, the central bank said Tuesday.
It said net reserves increased by $16.6 million between June 6 to 13.
Gross foreign reserves stood at $10.74 billion at the same date, the central bank said. About $9.5 billion of the reserves have been placed in foreign banks as fixed term deposits.
